hero.bio: I'm a freelance web designer in Tilburg. There's no agency behind Noxta, just me. I do the design, write the copy, and write the code. After launch I stick around to fix things and add new ones as you need them. You email me, I email you back.

intro.label: 00 · Who I am
intro.sub: I work alone on purpose. Keeping the whole project in one head means nothing gets dropped between specialists who don't know your business as well as you do. The trade-off is capacity: I usually have two clients at a time, which is why slots are worth booking early.

servicesSection.label: 01 · What I do
servicesSection.sub: I handle the design, the copy, the code, and the payments myself. So there's no handoff between people who barely know each other, and if something breaks the person to call is me.

services.title: Websites
services.desc: Multi-page sites with SEO and analytics wired in from day one, not bolted on the week before launch.

services.title: E-commerce
services.desc: Real shops with real payment flows. VOEP runs 4,200 SKUs on the setup I built.

services.title: Brand
services.desc: Wordmark, palette, and type system. Enough so the site looks like a brand, not a template.

services.title: Maintenance
services.desc: I stick around after launch. Updates, backups, and the small edits you'd usually be afraid to ask for.

work.title: Szabina
work.sub: Szabina travels and writes about it. After a trip she puts up a short post: a title, a paragraph or two, and the photos she took. I built her a static, hand-coded site with a small admin she runs herself.

work.title: VOEP
work.sub: Alex runs a vintage outboard parts shop in Belgium. Sixty years of inventory, no website. We built him a 4,200-SKU store with IDEAL checkout and a product search I tuned by hand. First sale came within a week.

strip.text: One person · One studio · No handoffs

believe.p: Lots of freelancers ship and disappear. I don't. Retainer or ad-hoc, you can reach me after launch. That's usually when the real work starts anyway.
Generic sites look generic because nobody sweated the details. If a button is off by two pixels I'll catch it. So will your visitors, even if they can't quite say why something feels off.
When the project ends you own all of it: the code, the domain, the logins, the content. If you decide to take it somewhere else later, I'll help you move.

pricingSection.label: 04 · Pricing
pricingSection.sub: Honest ranges below. I quote you a fixed number after a 30-minute call, and that number doesn't move unless the scope does.

pricingOnetime.name: Small
feats: Single landing page or minor redesign
Simple brand mark or wordmark refresh
Up to 600 words of copy I write with you
pricingOnetime.ideal: A focused launch page or a one-off redesign for a side project. Usually takes one to two weeks.

pricingOnetime.name: Mid
pricingOnetime.desc: A full site with a real brand.
feats: Two rounds of revisions · 2–4 week turnaround
First 30 days of Standard retainer included
pricingOnetime.ideal: Small businesses without a site, or whose current one is hurting them. Most of my projects land here.

pricingOnetime.name: Large
feats: First 30 days of Standard retainer included
pricingOnetime.ideal: Shops with real inventory or custom flows that an off-the-shelf template can't handle. >2,000 SKUs quoted bespoke. VOEP was a Large.

pricingMonthly.name: Light
pricingMonthly.desc: Kept up to date and safe.
feats: 1 hour of edits per month, rolled forward up to 2 months
Annual prepay · 12 months for the price of 11
pricingMonthly.ideal: Finished sites that just need to stay alive and up to date.

pricingMonthly.name: Standard
feats: Annual prepay · 12 months for the price of 11
pricingMonthly.ideal: Sites that change a few times a month: pricing, menu, content updates.

pricingMonthly.name: Active
feats: Annual prepay · 12 months for the price of 11
pricingMonthly.ideal: Growing shops and active marketing: new pages, campaigns, and ongoing work.

careplus.name: Care+ FAQ assistant
careplus.desc: A small chat box on your site for the questions you already get by email ten times a week. Opening hours, prices, parking, do you take walk-ins. The answers come from a FAQ I write with you. When someone's ready to book, it sends them to your calendar. When it doesn't know the answer, it says so instead of guessing.
feats: Lives in the bottom corner of your site, in your colours
Answers come from a FAQ I write with you
I read every month's transcripts and tune it so it doesn't start making things up
API and hosting costs come out of the €89, not your card
careplus.footnote: Standard and Active retainers only. Limited availability for now. Ask if you'd like a spot.

cta.lede: Send me what you're working on and I'll come back within a day. If I can help, I'll quote you. If I can't, I'll tell you, and usually I know someone who can.

footer.bio: Adrian Tajti. A one-person studio in Tilburg. I work with small businesses, mostly Dutch and Belgian, who want a real person to call when something on their site needs changing.
